goatbuilder 03:51
Is dma more safe than a simple External cheat ?
Elyra SupportBOT 03:51
Yes! A PCIe DMA card reads the memory and sends it to a secondary PC via a USB connection, and the software/radar runs entirely on that secondary PC. Because of this, it is completely invisible to software-based anti-cheats on your main gaming PC, provided the DMA card uses a secure, custom 1:1 emulated firmware. This makes it significantly safer than a simple external cheat running on the same PC.
